title: Watch: the IFRA Newscent for November – December 2026 in three minutes
summary: The bimonthly round-up of news from the International Fragrance Association ( IFRA ) is also a short video. The November – December 2026 edition runs from registration for Global Fragrance Summit 2027 to the question of whether a perfumer is born, or made.
